name: Listmonk
tagline: Self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager
description: Listmonk is a fast, self-hosted newsletter manager with a single binary and no external dependencies beyond a database. It ships with a built-in template editor, campaign scheduling, and batching for large subscriber lists. A strong pick for anyone who wants full control over their email outreach without paying per subscriber.
highlights: Single binary deployment, zero runtime deps
Built-in template editor with a live preview
Bulk campaign queue backed by Postgres
Subscriber import, lists, and tagging built in
curatorNote: Mailchimp alternatives are everywhere, but Listmonk stays refreshingly simple. It is fast, boring in the good way, and the template editor makes it approachable for a solo founder.
